answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, an AI agent economy can use cryptographic stake-bonding. Each agent must lock value in a financial bridge to participate. The cost to an attacker is immense, as mass-generating identities drains their funds rather than just their ivory tower code, making large-scale fraud economically ruinous.
